source: gold reel DdFEiOLy5h1 (cevrico, 361K views), adapted for fomo
note: Every turn gets its own shot, both trading moments are screen inserts followed by a reaction, and clip 2 opens on an insert after the time jump.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image and shown exactly:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>
<cast>
char:1 Aiden, teen trader
char:2 Dad
char:3 Jay, Aiden's mentor
</cast>
<places>
place:1 Aiden's bedroom trading setup
</places>
<video_model>Seedance 2.5: 4–30 s per clip, up to 30 reference images</video_model>
<script>
1| SCENE 1 — INT. AIDEN'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
2| Dad storms in. Aiden is at his monitors, his mentor Jay standing behind him.
3| DAD: You told my son to drop out of high school?
4| JAY: I told him to bet on himself.
5| DAD: Seven days. Ten grand. Or the computer goes.
6| Aiden's eyes snap wide.
7| AIDEN: Deal.
8| SCENE 2 — INT. AIDEN'S BEDROOM — NIGHT, SEVEN DAYS LATER
9| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Aiden's phone
10| AIDEN: I'm down seven thousand.
11| Dad leans in the doorway, arms crossed.
12| JAY: Don't you dare sell. Trust your setup.
13| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — fills the frame
14| AIDEN: Come on… come on… Ha! I did it!
15| DAD: Twenty-four thousand? On one trade?
16| Dad sinks onto the bed, stunned. Then he smiles.
17| DAD: Okay. Show me how.
18| AIDEN: Should I still go to school? Comment below.
</script>

output.hook: Dad bursts through the door shouting an accusation at the mentor in the first second; the stakes (school, ten grand, seven days) are set by second 6.

scenes.heading: INT. AIDEN'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
scenes.look: Dark bedroom lit by cold blue monitor glow, warm hallway light spilling in behind Dad; cables and energy cans in the foreground.

shots.speaker: Dad
shots.line: You told my son to drop out of high school?
shots.action: Dad bursts through the door and jabs a finger at Jay.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Dad in the doorway, fast push-in

shots.speaker: Jay
shots.line: I told him to bet on himself.
shots.reaction: Jay holds Dad's stare with a slow half-smile.
shots.camera: Low-angle medium close-up on Jay, static

shots.speaker: Dad
shots.line: Seven days. Ten grand. Or the computer goes.
shots.action: Dad leans over the desk at Aiden.
shots.camera: Tight close-up on Dad, brows crashed down
Extreme close-up on Aiden's eyes, snap zoom

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.action: Aiden sets his jaw and turns back to the monitors.
shots.camera: Close-up on Aiden, monitor light on his face

scenes.heading: INT. AIDEN'S BEDROOM — NIGHT, SEVEN DAYS LATER
scenes.look: Same room, colder and darker for the loss; the screens flare green on the win and warm every face.

shots.action: Aiden's phone shows the token falling.
shots.camera: Macro insert of the phone screen, static

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.action: Aiden stares at the screen, exhausted.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Aiden, cold blue light

shots.action: Dad watches from the doorway, arms crossed.
shots.camera: High wide shot from behind Aiden, Dad small in the doorway

shots.speaker: Jay
shots.line: Don't you dare sell. Trust your setup.
shots.action: Jay leans down to Aiden's ear.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Jay and Aiden, slow push-in

shots.action: The token rockets up on Aiden's phone.
shots.camera: Macro insert, phone fills the frame, static

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.line: Come on… come on… Ha! I did it!
shots.action: Aiden leaps up from the chair, fists clenched.

shots.speaker: Dad
shots.action: Dad sinks onto the bed, then smiles.
shots.reaction: Aiden and Jay trade a look.

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.line: Should I still go to school? Comment below.
shots.camera: Slow push-in on Aiden, direct to camera

clips.seam: Hard cut to seven days later.
